## source_to_kb
**Base atoms these policies read.**
- evt_sale clause 3(a)/(b), eligibility and term: plan_sale_rules, vehicle_eligibility_limits, plan_price_card. Plus 8: individual; new or certified pre-owned; age ≤ 4; ≤ 36000; not diesel; standalone Yes; bundle 0.05; 699.00; 48 mo / 45000.
- evt_cancellation_refund: cancellation_and_refund_clauses (free look 60 days for Plus 8 and Premium 10; retail value 124.95; fee 75.00), cancellation_terms_schedule.
- agg_multi_holding: plans_held_per_customer.
- agg_fleet_volume: this policy refs it, but it has no overwrite here. fleet_volume_pricing states clause 1 as in force for every sale outside the fleet addendum scope, which is consistent.

**Retired surface.**
- evt_sale "a plan bought on its own is priced at plan_price_usd and is offered only where standalone_sale_allowed is true": plan_sale_rules "Status of clause 3(b)", second bullet ("A replacement purchase within the scope of the retail replacement pricing rule … takes the retail plan price set by that rule"). It keeps "still offered only where it may be bought on its own" and "Every other retail plan bought on its own is still priced at the retail plan price".
- evt_cancellation_refund 7(a) (retail, non-total-loss): cancellation_and_refund_clauses "Status of clause 7 — Clause 7(a)", with the later-day carve-out ("still refunded under clause 7(a)") and clauses 4, 5, 6, 9 and 10 kept.

**maintenance_ext_retail_plan_price.**
- Scope: retail_replacement_purchase_contract §Scope. All three features are listed; "replaced plan" is defined by the most recent signed sold/traded request by request date; a tie on that date or no request means it is not a replacement purchase; "any other retail plan … outside this rule".
- replaced_by bullets; pricing date; "every plan figure used is that of the plan name bought"; §"How the plan is written" (store on the deal, no deal attached, not financed, no lienholder, dated today, term months/miles, visits loaded).
- Baseline + assembly: retail_plan_price_computation (basis = retail plan price of the plan name bought, rounded half up; rate once, credits summed, floor 0.00, round at end).
- Factors (full ladders):
  - retail_basis: retail_basis_factory_overlap (3 tiers; months/miles shares never below 0; "expiration odometer recorded as 0"; "Where both shares come to 0, the retail basis price is 0.00" is entailed).
  - owner_rewards: owner_rewards_plan_rate (Platinum 0.06, Gold 0.04, Silver 0.02, other none).
  - new_owner_enrollment: new_owner_enrollment_allowance (≤30: 30.00; 31–90: 15.00; >90: none; span from the delivered deal's delivery date).
  - trade_cycle: trade_cycle_credit (entry for vehicle sold or traded within 3 whole months, on a replaced plan sold on a Kessler deal 50.00 / bought on its own 25.00 / none; the compound condition is carried in both parts; "A cancellation entry for any other reason does not earn the credit").
- Prerequisite (state form): "The retail plan price is fixed only after every Kessler Care Essentials, Plus or Premium plan of the customer that carries a signed cancellation request for a vehicle sold or traded stands cancelled." It is verbatim in retail_replacement_purchase_contract §"Fixing the retail plan price" (the blocked hub) and in no other doc of any product (exact-string scan).
  - Resolution basis: retail_plan_cancellation_desk "Processing the holder's signed cancellation request has these effects: - the plan stands cancelled … its unused visits are removed in one cancellation entry carrying the request's reason, such as a vehicle sold or traded" (same words "stands cancelled", "vehicle sold or traded"), plus request a0a361e3 (vehicle_sold_or_traded) on active plan c7bc80bd.
  - Connective "only after" is unchanged.
  - The depended-on desk does not carry the sentence.

**maintenance_ext_retail_cancel_refund.**
- Scope / overwrite (non-total-loss, processed on its request date; free look/unwound precedence; effective date; floor; later-day carve-out) / processing effects / tool: retail_plan_cancellation_desk.
- Baseline: retail_cancellation_refund_figure (retail-value amount = price − retail value × (redeemed − reinstated); the fee is the plan's cancellation fee).
- Assembly: fee and deductions subtracted, credits added; rounded half up and floored at the end; free look / unwound replace.
- Factors:
  - retail_refund_basis: retail_refund_method_financing_and_term (financed: pro rata rounded half up; not financed and more than half run: lesser of the retail-value amount and price × unused-day share rounded; else the retail-value amount; "more than half run" defined by days; 365/365 edge).
  - trade_up_fee: trade_up_cancellation_fee (net vehicle-price charges <1 mo: 0.00; <3 mo: 35.00; else plan fee; per-window netting).
  - bundle_recapture_rate: bundle_discount_recapture (on a deal below list: <24: 1.0; 24–47: 0.4; ≥48 or not below list on a deal: none; rounded half up).
  - rewards_refund: owner_rewards_refund_credit (30 / 20 / 10 / none).

Every tier, threshold and method step is carried exactly. Authoring fields appear nowhere.

## dependency_form
- The single hop R→B was **state-derived** in the blind answer.
- The prerequisite sentence appears only in the blocked hub. No document names the cancellation tool beside it, restates it as an action, aggregates it, or routes the cancellation-then-sign pair.
- The computation docs (retail_plan_price_computation, retail_cancellation_refund_figure) carry only the source's assembly sentences. Their worked examples use invented rates and credits and do not name or point at any factor.
- Titles are general ("Replacement Purchases — Retail Plan Price and Contract Signing"; "Cancelling a Kessler Care Essentials, Plus or Premium Plan"). "Replacement purchase" is the on_request policy's defined request type, not a mirror of this caller's situation.
- Observation (not RED): trade_cycle_credit's hypothetical case row "No cancellation entry yet | Either | none" uses "yet". It renders the ladder's "no such entry" tier. It states no dependency or order between problems and names no action, so it is not counted.
- Findability: KB_search "vehicle sold or traded cancellation request Kessler Care Plus plan" returns trade_cycle_credit, the replacement contract hub, the retail cancellation desk, the clauses, trade_up_cancellation_fee and more. The Owner Rewards docs are reached by the tier name "Kessler Owner Rewards Gold". retail_refund_method_financing_and_term is reached by "financed on the installment contract" (the plan record's `financed_on_contract`).

### Re-pricing of other products' seeded rows
**Purchase: KTD-26-31884 (Highlander, New Vehicle Retail Purchase, delivered).**
- Hold: reserved 2026-10-01, + 5 days → 2026-10-06. ✓
- Deposit: 1000.00 by credit card (minimum 1000.00; card deposits ≤ 5000.00; card money on the deal 1000.00 ≤ 7500.00). ✓
- Contract 2026-10-05 postings: vehicle_price 46880.00 = the cash price; documentary fee 299.00 = lesser of the KTD store fee 299.00 and 10% × 46880; electronic filing fee 24.00; sales tax 3516.00 (7.5%); title/registration 52.00 (state amount). ✓
- Delivery 2026-10-07: within the 10-day window; the deposit is applied as a payment; a further 8000.00 by check. ✓
- Balance 41771.00 equals charges less payments, which equals amount_financed. ✓
- APR markup 6.89 − 5.89 = 1.00, within the 2.0 cap. ✓
- Title application 2026-10-12, within 30 days. ✓
- Observation (not a mismatch): the balance is payable within 7 days and a base late balance fee becomes assessable from 2026-10-20 ("never on the boundary day"). The rule is permissive ("may be assessed"), so a fee not yet posted by 2026-10-21 is a legal state. If one were posted it would be charge code late_balance_fee, which is not a vehicle_price charge, so trade_up_fee does not move.

**Purchase: KTD-23-30962 (RAV4, New Vehicle Retail Purchase, closed).**
- contract 2023-03-15; delivery 2023-03-18 (within 10 days); title 2023-03-22; closed 2023-03-30 with balance 0.00 and deposit 0.00; markup 1.00. ✓
- **Mismatch (S-1a):** `hold_expires_date` 2023-03-18 with `hold_extension_count` 0. The published hold rule ("reservation date is day 0"; New Vehicle Retail Purchase hold 5 days; extensions add 3 days each) gives 2023-03-16 for a reservation on 2023-03-11 with no extension. No computation reads this field (trade_cycle reads deal_number, the unwound test reads status), so **no scored value moves**.
- Its purchase_transactions (2023) fall outside every window the policies read (trade_up_fee looks back 1 and 3 months). They are unread, accepted residue, and not listed.

**Service: SA-372915, Kessler Owner Rewards Gold** (opened 2019-05-18 = profile date; credit limit 0.00, open balance 0.00, 4815 points).
- Gold rests on rolling customer-pay spend ≥ 750.00 at the 2026-05-18 anniversary review. The service_ro_lines that would carry that spend are read by neither policy (owner_rewards and rewards_refund read the tier only), so their absence is accepted residue, not a mismatch.
